PSF_section_3_and_CNRI_section_3.summary_text: The upstream producer supplied CPython 3.13.17 built with pgo+lto and its official install_only_stripped distribution. The project did not rebuild CPython, change native source, patch compiled code, or remove compiled-in modules. It curated the verified distribution by retaining the two core binaries, permitted pure-standard-library files and selected required runtime files, and excluding optional packages, tests, site-packages/pip/certifi, Tcl/Tk auxiliary payloads and the shared _dbm/_tkinter files under the declared selection policy. It supplemented the official legal notices and public provenance metadata. Upstream stripping/repacking changes file layout and removes non-runtime/debug material; the accepted static projection supports compiled loadable-payload provenance, not equality of raw file hashes or a runtime execution claim.
